chunks: It was narrated from Manṣūr ibn Ḥāzim that he said:
I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: A man places a date pit in his mouth while he is fasting. He said: “No.” I said: Then he places a ring? He said: “Yes.”
And whoever experiences a wet dream during the daytime in the month of Ramaḍān, then he should complete his fast, and there is no makeup fast upon him.

key_terms.احْتَلَمَ: experienced a wet dream involuntarily during sleep
key_terms.النَّوَاةَ: a date pit or seed placed in the mouth
key_terms.صَائِمٌ: a person who is observing the fast
key_terms.قَضَاءَ: makeup fasting required after invalidation or omission

ai.seo_question: Does putting something in the mouth or having a wet dream during the day invalidate the fast in Ramaḍān?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses fasting rulings related to placing objects in the mouth and involuntary seminal emission during the day in Ramaḍān. It indicates that placing a date pit in the mouth is not allowed for the fasting person, while placing a ring is allowed, and that a wet dream during the daytime does not invalidate the fast nor require qaḍāʾ.
